cards.example_en: The company plans to expand into Asia.
cards.example_zh: 该公司计划扩展到亚洲。

cards.example_en: I expect a letter from my uncle this week.
cards.example_zh: 我期待这周能收到叔叔的信。

cards.example_en: Can you explain this maths problem to me?
cards.example_zh: 你能把这道数学题解释给我听吗？

cards.example_en: We want to explore the old town this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我们想这个周末探索老城区。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：打架；战斗
cards.example_en: Those two boys should not fight in the hallway.
cards.example_zh: 那两个男孩不该在走廊里打架。

cards.example_en: Fill your bottle with water before the long hike.
cards.example_zh: 长途步行之前，把你的水瓶灌满水。

cards.example_en: I often find my keys in this coat pocket.
cards.example_zh: 我经常在这件外套的口袋里找到钥匙。

cards.example_en: Finish your soup before it gets completely cold.
cards.example_zh: 趁汤还没彻底凉掉，把它喝完。

cards.example_en: Dad can fix the broken chair on Saturday morning.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸星期六早上能把那把坏椅子修好。

cards.example_en: Focus on your own paper during the maths exam.
cards.example_zh: 数学考试时要专心看自己的试卷。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：跟随；遵循
cards.example_en: Follow the blue signs to the city library.
cards.example_zh: 沿着蓝色指示牌走到市图书馆。

cards.example_en: I sometimes forget my lunch box on the kitchen counter.
cards.example_zh: 我有时会把饭盒忘在厨房的台面上。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：自由的；空闲的
cards.example_en: I was free after the club, so I helped tidy the art room.
cards.example_zh: 社团活动结束后我有空，就帮忙收拾了美术教室。

cards.example_en: Wind can be used to generate electricity.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：得到；变得
cards.example_en: You get one point for each correct answer.
cards.example_zh: 每答对一题，你就得到一分。
